integrity: Proof and rational computations are disclosed. A finite second implementation tests consistency only; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The established (9,4) Toeplitz identity is a premise. The theorem concerns consecutive maximal-run lengths for the half-scaled digit convention, not all factors of the parity sequence, independence, a Markov law, or other rational bases. Historical priority remains subject to possible unindexed equivalent work.
title: All-order rational run statistics and the exact five-state run-transition law for the base-\(3/2\) Thue–Morse word
